calls.name: set_controller

args.code:
def control(obs):
    h = obs.get('hitch_deg', 0.0)
    walls = obs.get('views', {}).get('camera', {}).get('walls', [])
    left = [d for b, d in walls if 90 < b < 155]
    right = [d for b, d in walls if -155 < b < -90]
    bias = 5.0 if left and (not right or min(left) < min(right) + 0.8) else (-5.0 if right and (not left or min(right) < min(left) + 0.8) else 0.0)
    steer = max(-12.0, min(12.0, bias + 0.55*h))
    return (steer, -0.55, -23.0)
